steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: This was my last delivery stop today.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh, a fast food shop! My favorite!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Deep fried meat! Fries! Salt 'n pepper shrooms! Yeah, I want 'em all!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Huh? The girl isn't here.

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Wait, how many orders of fried meat, you said? Two? Twenty? Are you sure you can eat all that?

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Alright, who am I to complain? Ten with ketchup, ten with salt. Here you go—What about you, girl? What can I get you for?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Hm... mmm... Smells so good.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: No, I can't have stop for a midnight snack yet. I still have work to do.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Sorry, sir, but what happened to the girl who was reading in your restaurant this evening?

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Oh, her? She left. Probably trying to make her way back to the next town over.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: She's going overnight?

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Yeah, overnight. If she didn't leave right away, she probably wouldn't make it to see her old man for the last time.

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Eh, I think I remember now. You stopped by once in the evening, didn't you? Are you the Messenger who delivered the news to Emily?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I... Yeah, I did... I didn't know that's what it was about, though.

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Eh, Emily is studying here by herself. Whenever she has some free time, she helps me out with the shop to make some extra money.

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Her old man back home never failed to send her a monthly letter, but there's been nothing from him these past two months.

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: She was really worried about it, you know. She even came to you Messengers and asked if any of you missed his letters.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Baws, we know how to do our jobs. We don't just lose our mail.

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Right, right, right. I believe you. Emily trusts you, too, but, with no news from her family, she was really anxious.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: No wonder she seemed so happy when she saw me this evening.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: But then...

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Eh, what's that saying again? Life is unpredictable and you never know what's coming next. All of us are bound to die one day.

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Besides, if it wasn't for you delivering her old man's last letter to her, she wouldn't have known to rush home right away.

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: I'm sure she's really grateful.

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Right, did you need her for something?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Well... Never mind.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I guess this isn't hers.

steps.name: Fast Food Joint Owner
steps.text: Alright, if there's nothing else, you should get something to eat. I'll give you girls a discount!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: *Burp*—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Man, did I really eat all that? Darn it, spent all my money for the month again!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: The sun is coming up soon.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We sure ran all over town in just one night! Really had me starving. Huh, you ain't ate nothing!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Still thinking about Emily?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Well, maybe that's only part of it.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Since I heard her story, I just can't help but keep thinking that maybe there's someone out there waiting for news about me.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh, right, you haven't been back home in a long time, right?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: If just passing through counts, then it hasn't really been that long.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Eh, you ever thought about when to go back? Y'should contact your folks once, at least.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I'm not sure I'm ready yet.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ready fer what? Yer sickness is nice and stable fer now, ain't it? Ya were sayin' you'd rather yer folks think yer gone than watch ya writhe in pain, but what about now?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: If they think I've gone missing, then they'd probably still hold out hope that I'm doing okay somewhere in the world even after five or ten years.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But they're worried sick!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Besides, we've got all them doctors in Medical! What's five or ten years? You've got a long, bright future ahead of you!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh? Who's that?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I think I saw a... No, one, two, three... That's lots of fluffy tails.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Oh, it's Angelina and Croissant. G-Good morning.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Oh, hey there, Lisa. Good morning. Why are you up so early? Your wakeup time isn't for a while yet.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Um... Um... I wanted to take a look at that...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: 'That?' What do you mean, 'That?'

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Well, it's the notes...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I finished it yesterday, and I wanted to show it to you right away, but it was getting late. I-I didn't want Dr. Kal'tsit to yell at me for not going to bed on time...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But I really, really wanted to let you see it right away!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Is that why you left it in front of the dorm?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Yep... Yep!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I thought Angelina would be really happy to see it after she came home from work.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: My my, lookie here, Angelina. That package is yours, just like I said.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Let's open it up and take a look!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: It's... for me?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: It's wrapped so neatly... and it's my favorite color, pink. This scent... I thought it seemed familiar. It's that fragrance from the Medical Department the other day!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I-Is there a smell? I made it after I was done with homework.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Maybe the smell got on there while I was there?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Oh, it's not bad at all. I really like this aroma too. It makes me feel relaxed. Alright, I'm opening it up! 1, 2, 3!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: There's a booklet inside...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I remember this river... and these buildings... Oh, that's my favorite cafe!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: If you walk east for about ten minutes, you'll reach a street that I've probably walked hundreds, no, thousands of times.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Also... this petal... I think I know this smell...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: My dad sent me the petals!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Most of the stuff in the beginning is photos that my mom's friend sent, but I also drew lots of things from memory too. It still looks kinda ugly, though... Even though I've been practicing...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: No, they look so pretty!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: All of it looks so, so nice.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Um, Angelina... D-Did I do something wrong? You don't seem happy... Are you sad?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: No, I'm not sad.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I'm just... overwhelmed.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Ever since I... I haven't seen any of this while it's still bright out.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I thought I'd left all this somewhere far, far away long ago... It's so distant, I thought I'd never get there again no matter how fast I ran.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Yep, Rhodes Island is a big, biiiig ship, and it's always going somewhere.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: When I first got here, I'd always ask Folinic where we were at the time, and I would try to figure out how far we were from Siracusa and Higashi.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Sometimes we were close, and sometimes we were far away. Then I lost track.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But every time I get a letter from my mom or dad, or their friends, I hug the letter before bed. It makes me feel like I'm right there snuggling up to my parents.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: After a while, I got so many letters that they would overflow the bed if I took them all... Mm, so I put some of them in a booklet.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: That way, I can go to bed hugging the booklet!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Yep... You're so cute, Lisa.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh? Is that weird?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Nope, what you said actually makes a lot of sense.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Doctor told me that not only are our Messengers always on the road making deliveries, they need to take care of their Rhodes Island work too. It's a lot of hard work, and I thought it might have been a while since you've been home.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: The Doctor even complimented me on my notebook! Said I was amazing!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Doctor says you might need to try something this...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: The Doctor said that...?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Yep, and everyone else too, not just the people working at Rhodes Island! There was the Siracusan Messenger who gave me stuff before.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I don't remember when everybody started doing it, but whenever they go to Siracusa or Higashi, they would bring back photos or the local specialties there for me.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hoowee, sounds like everybody's a Messenger now!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Right, they're just like all of our amazing Messengers! So I put all those things in my booklet. It's one of my most precious treasures!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I think to myself every day that, by the time the book is full, I'll be all grown up! I'll be so much more amazing than I am now.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: It'll be my turn to protect everyone and my mom and dad.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Dad won't stay up all night worrying about me, and Mom won't need to keep working herself to death for me anymore.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: When that day comes, I'll finally get to go home!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: So, after Doctor talked to me about it, I thought I'd make one for you too...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You can't go home for some reason, right?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: It's a promise! I'll give you another one once I get new photos, Angelina!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: That way, your book will fill up even faster, and you'll get to go home sooner!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Thanks. Thanks so much... This is a wonderful present.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Oh, it's my wake-up time now! I can't let Dr. Kal'tsit and Folinic find out I've been running around... I need to get back home! See you, Angelina, Croissant!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Darn, I wish I'd put money on that.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What'd I tell ya. Yer such a cutie, yer bound to get a buncha cute presents!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Uh... yeah.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I never even noticed. I guess I've long become a part of Rhodes Island, and there are people here who care about me.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I'm no longer... the girl went gone missing.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: *Yawn*—I'm getting tired. Did you say somethin' just now, Angelina? I didn't hear.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: N-Nothing.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I was just saying that I really like Lisa's present.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Just like I said, ain't it? This night's full o' surprises!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Wonder if I should go back fer a nap now. Maybe some chow instead...? Yeah, guess I'll grab a bite to eat.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What about you? You didn't sleep the whole night. This is gonna ruin that beauty plan of yours.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I'll take a break and then head to training after a while.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I got classes in the afternoon too...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I may have work to keep up with, but I can't fall behind with my studies either!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh? No kiddin'? You turnin' workaholic or something?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I'm not.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Will I get to go home... when the book is all filled up?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Am I ready for that?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: How long has this letter been on my desk...? A few months? Half a year?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: 'Dear Mom and Dad—'

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: 'Everything is going well over here...'

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: 'I have a really good job, and I'm keeping up with my studies...'

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: 'Yes, I got Oripathy, but you don't need that worry. It happened that day on my way to school...'

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: 'I was in a rush to make it to club... I told Dad I didn't need a ride. If I were just a little more careful, maybe I wouldn't have bumped into that car fresh back from the wilds.'

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: 'None of this is Dad's fault.'

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I'll keep the letter in this page.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I'll be ready one day, and I know Mom and Dad will be ready too.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: When I'm finally done with this letter, I'll take it to the place in the photo myself. Yeah, the third house on this street from the east. I'll draw a heart here.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: That day is going to be here soon. I know it.
